name: Pork Tenderloin Medallions with Creamy Dijon Sauce
ingredients_verbatim: 1 - 1 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, silver skin and visible fat removed
2 Tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, DIVIDED
1/4 cup shallot, diced, or yellow onion together with a small clove of garlic
1/2 cup dry white wine, or more chicken broth
1 Tablespoon Dijon mustard, or more to taste
1 Tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped or 1 teaspoon dried parsley
why: Pork tenderloin (the thinnest lane and a cut the run specifically wants) in a French Dijon-white-wine cream pan sauce. Published nutrition is dead-center of the band: 470 cal, 38g protein, 7g carbs. Structurally low-carb - tenderloin medallions in a cream sauce, no starch base. Every ingredient maps to the board (pork-tenderloin, olive-oil, butter, shallots, white-wine, chicken-broth, heavy-cream, dijon-mustard, fresh-parsley, cornstarch). Distinct from the existing creamy-asiago-pork-tenderloin-medallions candidate by its Dijon/white-wine profile rather than a cheese cream, but flagging that adjacency for the adjudicator. Scales by weigh-and-divide. Nutrition read directly from the recipe card, high confidence.
